no5-26jun1801.summary: Murray, in Paris to exchange the ratifications of the Convention of 1800, tells Madison that in the conferences with the French ministers nothing has yet been said about the armed neutrality, the northern powers' league of 1800-01.
no5-26jun1801.en: P.S. As to the armed neutrality not a Word has yet been said —
